methodology: OWASP AIVSS v0.8 (formula unchanged) — Reva input corrections v1.1

threatMultiplierOptions.note: DEFAULT — use unless a known exploit targets this specific agent

mitigationMap.note: Controls UNKNOWN, not absent. Neutral default until an assessment sets a real level.

factorCatalog.label: Autonomy
factorCatalog.definition: Degree to which the agent acts and decides without human approval.

factorCatalog.label: Tools
factorCatalog.definition: Breadth and privilege of tools / functions the agent can invoke.

factorCatalog.label: Language
factorCatalog.definition: Reliance on unstructured natural-language input (prompt-injection surface).

factorCatalog.label: Context
factorCatalog.definition: Use of broad or external data/context that can be manipulated.

factorCatalog.label: Non-Determinism
factorCatalog.definition: Variability and unpredictability of the agent's outputs.

factorCatalog.label: Opacity
factorCatalog.definition: Lack of transparency, logging, or auditability of actions.

factorCatalog.label: Persistence
factorCatalog.definition: Memory or state retained across sessions.

factorCatalog.label: Identity
factorCatalog.definition: Ability to assume roles or act under delegated identity / credentials.

factorCatalog.label: Multi-Agent
factorCatalog.definition: Coordinates with or spawns other agents (cascading blast radius).

factorCatalog.label: Self-Modification
factorCatalog.definition: Ability to alter its own code, prompts, or configuration.

recommendedActionCatalog.title: Govern Agent
recommendedActionCatalog.description: Assign an owner and attach an authorization policy to bring the agent under governance.

recommendedActionCatalog.title: Enforce A2A Auth
recommendedActionCatalog.description: Enforce runtime authorization on sub-agent spawning, scoped to the delegating user's limits.

recommendedActionCatalog.title: Scoped Tokens
recommendedActionCatalog.description: Issue task-scoped tokens to connected tools instead of standing credentials.

recommendedActionCatalog.title: Audit Trail
recommendedActionCatalog.description: Enable decision logs with trace IDs to make every action auditable.

recommendedActionCatalog.title: Gate Self-Modification
recommendedActionCatalog.description: Require review for code/config changes and sign provenance.

recommendedActionCatalog.title: Maintain Controls
recommendedActionCatalog.description: Controls are adequate; re-score on any capability or permission change.

formulas.severity: band from severityBands by aivss score (standard CVSS cut-offs retained)

baseScoreRubric.description: Per-agent CVSS-style base (replaces the flat per-risk-category constant). Balanced profile: unknown data sensitivity adds +1.0.
baseScoreRubric.note: Re-score an agent's base once discovery fills in real dataSensitivity / tool scope.

changeLog: v1.1: cvssBase now derived per-agent from reach + data sensitivity + exposure (was flat per risk-category).
v1.1: Discovered mitigation factor 1.0 -> 0.9 (Unassessed); discovery no longer implies absent controls.
v1.1: threatMultiplier defaults to Unreported (0.5) unless a known exploit exists for the agent.
v1.1: severity bands unchanged (Critical>=9, High>=7, Medium>=4). Formula unchanged from AIVSS v0.8.
